$comment: limen's command surface, captured as the parity oracle for Brumista's first milestone. Not W72's own protocol: that is protocol/commands.json. Shapes use JSON values as type names; a key ending in ? may be absent, and [T] is an array of T.

source.checked: 2026-11-01, against the source and a running limen (Rack 2.6.6, Windows): every command except quit, save_patch, save_patch_as and set_fullscreen, the writes on two scratch modules that were removed afterwards

transport.framing: one JSON object per line, newline-terminated, both ways; empty lines are ignored
transport.clients: one at a time; a second connection waits for the first to close

the command's params, at the top level

ok.result: the command's result; null for commands that return nothing

transport.threads: commands marked main are queued and run in limen's widget step(); the server thread waits 2 s for them (10 s for save_patch and save_patch_as), then replies with the timeout error while the queued work may still run

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Protocol version and the commands this limen supports.

commands.name: list_plugins
commands.description: Every plugin loaded in Rack.

commands.name: list_models
commands.description: Every module model Rack can create, optionally for one plugin.

plugin.description: plugin slug; an unknown slug returns an empty list

commands.name: list_modules
commands.description: The modules in the patch, with grid position and width.

plugin.description: plugin slug; an unknown slug returns an empty list

commands.name: get_module
commands.description: One module, in the shape list_modules uses.
commands.result: same object as one list_modules entry

commands.name: get_module_info
commands.description: What Rack's right-click Info menu shows: model metadata, tags and the plugin's identity and links.

commands.name: list_ports
commands.description: A module's inputs and outputs by index, with their names.

inputs.name: string, empty when the port has no name

outputs.name: string, empty when the port has no name

notes: Lists every port the engine module declares, including ports with no jack on the panel (see problem panel-jack).

commands.name: list_params
commands.description: A module's parameters: current value, name, range and unit.

commands.name: get_param
commands.description: One parameter, in the shape list_params uses.
commands.result: same object as one list_params entry

commands.name: set_param
commands.description: Set a parameter's value.

value.description: new value, sent to Engine::setParamValue as a float

notes: Runs on the server thread, not the main-thread queue.
The value is not clamped: 12 on a parameter with range 0 to 1 reads back as 12. limen-mcp's tool description says Rack clamps it.

commands.name: list_cables
commands.description: The cables in the patch, optionally only those touching one module.

id.description: only cables with this module at either end

commands.name: add_module
commands.description: Create a module and its widget; place it at a grid position, or next to an existing module when no position is given.

x.description: grid column in HP; x and y go together

y.description: grid row; x and y go together

mode.description: what to do when the position is taken; used only with x and y

errors: x and y must both be numbers
unknown mode (expected nearest, force, squeeze, or strict)
notes: An unknown mode or a strict clash is only caught after the module has been created; limen then removes it again, and list_modules shows no leftover.

commands.name: remove_module
commands.description: Remove a module and its cables.

commands.name: move_module
commands.description: Move a module to a grid position and report where it landed.

mode.description: what to do when the position is taken

errors: unknown mode (expected nearest, force, squeeze, or strict)
notes: Every mode but strict may land the module somewhere other than x, y: nearest moved a module asked for x 2 to x 9, next to the module already there.
Fractional positions snap to the grid: x 12.6 landed at 13.

commands.name: add_cable
commands.description: Connect an output to an input.
errors: missing outputModule, outputPort, inputModule, or inputPort
color must be a string "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa"
notes: Port ranges are checked against the engine module's port counts, not the panel's jacks (see problem panel-jack).
No check that the input is free. What Rack does with a second cable on one input through this path was not tested.

commands.name: remove_cable
commands.description: Remove a cable.

commands.name: save_patch
commands.description: Save the patch to its own file, or to path as a copy that leaves the patch's path alone.
errors: patch has never been saved; use save_patch_as with a path

commands.name: save_patch_as
commands.description: Rack's Save as: write the patch to path and make it the patch's file.

commands.name: set_fullscreen
commands.description: Enter or leave fullscreen; reports the resulting state.

commands.name: zoom_to_modules
commands.description: Fit the view to all modules, as Rack's F4 does.
notes: Replies at once; the zoom runs over the next three frames.

commands.name: quit
commands.description: Close Rack's window.
notes: No save prompt: unsaved changes are lost. Not called while capturing this file.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run a list of commands in order in one round trip.
request objects, each with its own cmd

stopOnError.description: stop after the first failing command

result.stopped?: integer, index of the command that stopped the batch
results: each command's own reply, { ok, result } or { ok, error }

notes: The envelope is ok whenever the batch is well formed; failures are inside results.
A nested batch is refused inside results with "batch cannot be nested", and a non-object entry with "command must be an object".
Commands that already ran are not undone when a later one fails.

problems.summary: Cables added through the protocol had no colour: a new CableWidget is transparent black, so only the plugs drew.
problems.status: fixed in forsitan 2.17.1, which also added add_cable's color param
problems.brumista: Every new cable gets the requested colour or RackWidget::getNextCableColor().

problems.summary: add_cable accepts any port index below the engine module's port count. Some modules declare ports with no jack on the panel (NYSTHI Programmer input 19); a cable to one of those crashed Rack.
problems.status: open in 2.17.2: the check is unchanged. Seen in use, not reproduced while capturing this file.
problems.brumista: Validate port indices against the PortWidgets the panel actually has, and turn every exception into an error reply.

problems.summary: No command pushes a Rack history action, so nothing done through limen can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
problems.status: open in 2.17.2: limen.cpp has no history calls
problems.brumista: Every write pushes a history action; a batch could be one complex action.

problems.summary: set_param writes from the server thread, outside the main-thread queue the other writes use.
problems.brumista: All writes run through the main-thread queue.

problems.summary: A command that times out waiting for the main thread is still queued and may run after the client has been told it failed.
